About_&_Key_Points:
About
D.B. Corp Ltd is engaged in the business of publishing newspapers, radio broadcasting, providing integrated internet and mobile interactive services and event management. Its major brands include Dainik Bhaskar (Hindi daily), Divya Bhaskar and Saurashtra Samachar (Gujarat daily) and Divya Marathi (Marathi daily).
[1]
Key Points
Business Segments:
a) Print Division:
[1]
As India’s largest print media company,
DBCL
publishes 5 newspapers
, namely,
Dainik Bhaskar (~43 editions), Divya Bhaskar (~8 editions), Divya Marathi (~6 editions), and Saurashtra Samachar and DB Star in 3 different languages, i.e., Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi.
Under this division, the company also publishes monthly magazines such as ‘Aha Zindagi’, ‘Bal Bhaskar’, Young Bhaskar, Navrang, Rasrang, Kalash, Madhurima, Lakshya and Dharmdarshan.
[2]
b) Radio Division:
[1]
In the FM radio segment, the brand has a presence in ‘94.3 MY FM’, which is available
in 7 states and 30 cities, creating a valuable package for advertisers in tier II and III cities. The company launched 7 new stations in FY26.
[3]
c) Digital Business:
[1]
DB Corp has an online presence with
4 internet portals and 4 mobile applications
.
It holds ~67% of the Indian language media space. DBCL is the No.1 digital player in Hindi and Gujarati languages as well. DBCL has launched “Dainik Bhaskar” App – a new app
that is set to provide news in the Hindi-speaking markets. It also launched a new version of the Divya Bhaskar App to strengthen its leadership position in Gujarat.
[4]
App Users:
- News-app monthly active users grew from ~1.6 million in 2020 to 16.8 million in March 2026 and ~
19-20 million
by May/June 2026.
